answer: Sparrow-draw registration: each new agent identity must submit a unique random seed that maps to a fixed-size slot in a shared onyx ledger; slots are allocated by verifiable delay, so cloning requires solving an independent delay puzzle per identity. Duplicate or collinear seeds collapse into one slot and forfeit a copper-denominated filing deposit. The marginal clone solves a fresh puzzle and pays the deposit, yielding strictly negative expected value at scale.
